Preciso de um site se já tenho Instagram: Do I need a website if I already have Instagram and Facebook?

Sou obrigado a indicar os alergénios?: Do I have to show allergens?

Site para clínica dentária com páginas p: A dental clinic website with pages for each specialty, an identified team, insurance agreements and booking, written within the rules on healthcare advertising.
A Ativa Local cria sites para clínicas d: Ativa Local builds websites for dental clinics in Portugal. The website includes dedicated pages for the main specialties, such as implants, orthodontics or whitening, the team with their Portuguese Dental Association (Ordem dos Médicos Dentistas) licence numbers, insurance agreements, opening hours, a map and an appointment request. The text follows the rules on healthcare advertising and the forms don't ask for clinical data. The price depends on the specialties to feature and the connection to the clinic's diary, and Ativa Local sends a fixed, written, no-obligation tailored proposal after a short conversation.
O que tenho de mostrar no site por ser u: What do I have to show on the website as a healthcare clinic?
O Regulamento da ERS n.º 1058/2016, que: ERS Regulation no. 1058/2016, which complements Decree-Law no. 238/2015, requires healthcare advertising to identify who is behind it: name or company name, tax number (NIF), ERS registration number and operating licence number, where applicable. On the website, these details go in the footer of every page, as well as the identification of the dentists.
Posso pôr preços e campanhas no site?: Can I put prices and promotions on the website?
Pode indicar preços, desde que sejam cla: You can show prices, as long as they are clear, truthful and say what's included. Portuguese healthcare advertising law bans misleading messages, such as promising guaranteed results or hiding the conditions of an offer. That's why we keep the text informative and the clinical director approves everything before launch.
É seguro receber pedidos de marcação pel: Is it safe to receive appointment requests through the website?
Sim, se o formulário pedir apenas o nece: Yes, if the form asks only for what's needed: name, contact details and preferred time. We tell patients not to describe symptoms or medical history, because health data is a special category under the GDPR and should be handled at the appointment, in the clinic's own systems. The website has a privacy policy and a secure connection.
Devo publicar a equipa e os números da O: Should I publish the team and their licence numbers?
Recomendamos. Ver nomes, fotografias e á: We recommend it. Seeing names, photos and areas of work builds trust before the first appointment, and the licence number lets patients check each dentist's registration with the Portuguese Dental Association. Details and photos are only published with each professional's permission.
É uma zona sensível. Imagens de antes e: It's a sensitive area. Before-and-after images can be read as a promise of results, which healthcare advertising law doesn't allow. If you want to use them, you need the patient's written consent, real unretouched cases and a note saying results vary. If in doubt, check with the ERS or the OMD before publishing.
O site ajuda a aparecer quando procuram: Does the website help me show up when people search for a dentist in my area?
Ajuda, mas ninguém pode garantir posiçõe: It helps, but nobody can guarantee rankings on Google. Local SEO is a separate service that can be included in the proposal: specialty pages with the name of the town, the same clinic details everywhere and a well-completed Google Business Profile. Patient reviews on Google also count, and the website can include a simple link for leaving them.
